scripts.db:seed: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=seed/catalog.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --local --file=seed/dev.sql
scripts.db:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/state/v3/d1 && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.db:migrate:preview: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview
scripts.db:seed:preview: node scripts/build-seed.mjs && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env preview --file=seed/catalog.sql && wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --env preview --file=seed/dev.sql
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env preview && wrangler deploy --env preview
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env staging && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env production && wrangler deploy --env production
